headline: Will Salesforce’s (CRM) US$1.6 Billion VA AI Deal Redefine Its Government-Cloud Narrative?
summary: Earlier this month, the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs awarded Salesforce, via its distribution network, a three-year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement with a total contract ceiling of US$1.60 billion to expand Missionforce, Agentforce, Slack, MuleSoft, Tableau, and Data 360 across its nationwide care network. The agreement spotlights how a large federal healthcare system is turning to Salesforce’s AI agents and unified data stack to support around 17 million Veterans with more...
